newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Coles to refocus K-Mart, Myer stores.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Coles to refocus K-Mart, Myer stores.

text.p: Coles Myer Ltd said on Tuesday it was in the process of rebuilding its K-Mart and Myer Grace retail businesses to give them a stronger customer focus.
"At Myer Grace Bros, like K-Mart, we have gone right back to basics and reviewed everything we do to focus on delivering what our custonmers want," chairman Nobby clark told the annual meeting.
Clark said Coles regarded the discount retailer K-Mart and department store operator Myer Grace as its underperforming businesses.

"K-Mart's profit downturn was due to a combination of factors, a poor Christmas, too much emphasis on low margin consumable products, excessive and costly promotion of discounted goods, and the difficult apparel market."
Costs were being stripped out of K-Mart and invested in lower prices for customers, Clark said.
K-Mart's merchandise mix had been completely reviewed and a new store design format had been introduced, he said.
He said the Myer Grace merchandise range had also been revised and customer service and product knowledge were being improved.
"A new concept of department store retailing is also about to be introduced which will take our Myer Grace Bros stores into the 21 century," Clark said.

Coles Myer, Australia's largest department store operator and one of the two largest grocery retailers, suffered a sharp downturn in 1995/96 net profit to A$280.4 million from A$423.4 million a year earlier.
